methodology_note: In-process simulators are deterministic (no RNG, no concurrency). Each profile is therefore run at N=1; multi-profile cells (e.g. the 50-profile AC-01 sweep) establish consistency across profiles, not repeated identical trials. The ≥95% finding threshold applies only to multi-profile cells (n ≥ 2); single-profile cells are reported with the threshold marked not applicable.
